class.name: MaszynaHeightmapTerrainRegion
class.brief_description: A region of a heightmap terrain as streaming supplies it.
class.description: A streaming cell of 1 km of a heightmap terrain - [constant CHUNKS_SIDE] chunks along its side - with its chunks read and the terrain it is drawn in: what [MaszynaHeightmapTerrainProvider] supplies as [constant SceneryStreamingProvider.CONTENT_HEIGHTMAP] and [MaszynaHeightmapTerrainRenderingServer] draws.

method.name: chunk_get_region
method.description: The region holding the chunk of [param key].

method.name: get_chunks
method.description: Its chunks, [constant CHUNKS_SIDE] squared in rows of growing z, null where there is none - a hole in the terrain.

method.name: get_key
method.description: Its key, the streaming cell it is.

method.name: get_terrain
method.description: The terrain it is drawn in.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Takes the [param terrain] it is drawn in, its [param key] and its [param chunks], as [method get_chunks] gives them.

constants.constant: The chunks of a region along its side: a streaming cell of 1 km of chunks of 250 m.
